GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When quest re tactics, Rdr said from wide gate & with mount being first up, instructed to settle towards rear & ride for luck in straight. When asked about ride from 600m, Rdr explained given mare was travelling well, and in an attempt to comply with instructs, elected to ride for luck attempting runs through field, rather than shifting wider at that stage. Rdr agreed should have shown more vigour between 600m & 450m to improve into race, where would have been able to obtain clear run at the entrance to straight. Rdr added mare would appreciate a step up in distance.
